title: Fix Video Behavior on Page Load
description: There's an issue with the video when the page first loads, without any user interaction.

acceptanceCriteria.text: BROWSER TEST: Navigate to song page fresh (hard refresh)
Document what happens: Does video autoplay? Error? Wrong state?
Video should NOT autoplay on page load (verified - paused by default)
Video should be paused and muted by default (verified - VolumeX icon shown)
No console errors on load (verified - only Vite connection logs)
User must click a line or play button to start playback (verified)
BROWSER TEST: Verify video is visible within 5 seconds of page load (no more infinite spinner)
